g.title: nvl72
g.text: GB200 NVL72: every GPU has one NVLink to every switch chip, so any two GPUs are one switch hop apart

g.title: SW
g.text: 9 NVLink switch trays = 18 NVLink 5 Switch chips
(72 ports each: one port per GPU; 7.2 TB/s per chip)

g.title: GP
g.text: 1 link to each of the 18 chips
18 compute trays = 72 Blackwell GPUs + 36 Grace CPUs
Check: 72 GPUs x 18 links = 1,296 links = 18 chips x 72 ports.
Each link = 2 lanes x 200 Gb/s each way = 4 copper pairs, so the spine holds 5,184 pairs (repo calc).
GPU 1 to GPU 72: out on any of its 18 links, through one switch chip, into that chip's port for GPU 72.
